what_happened: Job 20261028-081326-zzxg ("Free producer build dir before verifier; resume retry from kept") failed in planning, before any code was written. After round 3 of 3 the critic still said the plan needed revising. It found the named functions and seams exist, and agreed with the fix: target/produce is deleted after the checks pass and before the pre-verifier gate, and timeout_seed should know about the resume stage. Two major findings remained. (1) The test for criterion 6 cannot pass even with the fix. Its reader reports 9.5 GB as soon as target/produce exists, so the job stops at the disk gate before the checks (run/mod.rs:1980), before the removal runs. (2) The plan leaves out the "interrupted process" cause that the request and criterion 3 both require. Three minor findings: the reader still runs on retry and the test should say so; is_resumable_stop nearly duplicates disk::is_environment_reason; counting reads of the free-space function in the criterion 2 test is fragile. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered.
cause: The planner designs tests and coverage from the intended change and a list of the request's causes, not from a trace of the run path up to the point under test. It never checks that its fixture reaches the code being fixed, or that each cause named in the request and criteria maps to a step in the plan. The critic is the first stage to trace the gate order, and it has three rounds and keeps no partial plan. A late finding on an otherwise sound plan fails the whole job. The job targets the disk-stop failure itself, and its retry started from the same sort of state as the earlier stops.
prevention: Add a planning check that runs before the critic. For each criterion, the plan must list the ordered gates and steps its demonstration passes through before the code under test, with file:line, and must show the fixture reaches that code. It must also map every cause or case named in the request and criteria to a plan step, and flag any unmapped one. The critic gets this table as input, and a plan without it is returned at once without using a round. Also keep the last plan and its open findings so a failure in round 3 can resume with a fourth round limited to the remaining major findings.
proposed_request: Retry job 20261028-081326-zzxg. Outcome: a job that passes its checks must free its producer build directory (target/produce) before the pre-verifier disk gate, so a stop on low disk, a timeout, or an interrupted process can be retried and resumed without starting from the same low-disk state. Requirements: (1) The retry for each of these three causes (low-disk stop, timeout, interrupted process) must resume from the kept state. Use the existing disk::is_environment_reason rather than adding a near-duplicate, and make timeout_seed aware of the resume stage. (2) Before writing the plan, trace the gates in run/mod.rs in order (the disk gate near line 1980, the checks, the removal near line 2178, the pre-verifier gate), and give each criterion a test whose fixture gets past every earlier gate to the code under test. In particular, the criterion 6 test must not report 9.5 GB free before the checks run, since that stops the job at the earlier gate. (3) The plan must cover the interrupted-process cause explicitly and tie it to the existing recognition of interrupted jobs and recovery of their invocation records. (4) Note that the reader agent still runs on `athena retry`, and say so in the test. In the criterion 2 test, check with a marker file, not a count of free-space reads. Acceptance: each criterion has a test that fails on the old code and passes on the new code, and the full check suite passes.
